Managing Daily Stress and Energy
Daily mental and physical energy fluctuates based on work demands, sleep
consistency, and nutrition. Self-Care Interventions for Mild Energy Dip: -
Take structured short breaks (5-10 minutes) every 2 hours during long work
tasks. - Maintain consistent sleep-wake cycles even on weekends. - Avoid
excessive caffeine ingestion late in the afternoon. - Engage in gentle
stretching or short outdoor walks to improve circulation.
